verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes vLLM's general features (quantization, parallelism, API server, hardware support) but never mentions CLI flags or command-line arguments for setting GPU memory offload (e.g., gpu-memory-utilization) or context length (max-model-len) when loading a model. Missing for 10: any documentation or example of CLI-based configuration for GPU offload and context length, and any hands-on confirmation from users of doing so.
